correctness.rationale: Exact stationary-state reduction gives a polynomial of degree at most two, with a nonvanishing coefficient combination even in affine degenerate cases; a=0 yields an affine negative-cost payoff equation. Rational parameters produce exactly two distinct interior endemic roots, certified by disjoint exact rational brackets, and stable no-adherence endemic state. The explicit Jacobian coefficients, positive margins and -BChG′ determinant identity prove an interior saddle and an interior sink by cubic Routh–Hurwitz; hyperbolic implicit-function continuity yields nearby robustness. Symbolic code was executed against actual contents and confirms the needed arithmetic, but infinite statements rest on the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating full-text preprint provides the SIRS-adherence equations, the equilibrium function G, and a general Jacobian and illustrates abandonment/full-adherence bistability and partial/full coexistence. It does not establish an attained uniform bound of two mixed endemic stationary states or an exact hyperbolic witness with both no-adherence and partial-adherence endemic sinks. Its formulas are credited and their stronger potential implications checked. The earlier full-text SIRS adherence article uses a different simpler transmission/behavior mechanism. Several retrieved related published findings concern distinct systems; their claims do not entail this fixed-model result. Bibliographic incompleteness is an explicit risk.
residual_risks: No exhaustive search of unindexed research proves novelty; a stronger unlocated same-model theorem might imply the algebraic maximum or exact bistability pattern.

value.rationale: The recently studied two-route protection/conformity model naturally raises how many mixed endemic states may coexist and whether abandoning protection can coexist stably with partial adoption. The sharp root count and exact robust construction resolve both: two locally stable endemic states at adherence 0 and roughly 0.257, separated locally by a mixed saddle near 0.027, without any full-adherence endemic state. Distinct qualitative stable outcomes under identical rates are mathematically meaningful; no paper-sized/global theorem or empirical effect is claimed.
